title: Estrada asks court to reconsider dropping of Bonoan in plunder, graft cases
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Jinggoy Estrada urged the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division to revisit its move to allow for the dropping of graft and plunder cases against former DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Jinggoy Estrada urged the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division to revisit its move to allow for the dropping of graft and plunder cases against former DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan.
